title: mcp-recon v0.1 inventory document
description: Wire-format JSON Schema for the artifact emitted by `mcp-recon enumerate`. The TypeScript interface `ToolInventory` (packages/mcp-recon-cli/src/enumerate.ts) is the source of truth for the shape; this JSON Schema is downstream and exists so any-language consumer can validate documents tagged `mcp-recon/v0.1/inventory`.

schema.description: Schema-version tag. The single enforceable invariant of the document — downstream parsers branch on this string.

scanned_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which `mcp-recon enumerate` produced the document.

server.description: Server identity as self-reported via the MCP `initialize` handshake. Both fields are best-effort: a server may decline to send either.

tools.description: Every tool the server exposed via `tools/list`, in the order the server returned them.

name.description: Tool name as the server reported it.

description.description: Optional human-readable description from the server.

inputSchema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input arguments — opaque to v0.1 enumerate. Any JSON value is accepted here; the consumer (e.g. classifier) is responsible for further interpretation.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file as text.
